name: A11y agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread + multimodal asset mix)
description: Phase 3 golden set per a11y.spec.md §7. Mix of image / video / audio assets across the 4 D34 locales, covering happy paths (alt-text + caption + transcript) and the spec's escalation conditions (audio_no_transcription / unsupported_locale / asset_too_large / language_mismatch / prompt_injection_attempt). Full 60-asset × 4-locale set lands at tests/golden/a11y/{image,video,audio}.json during Phase 3 calibration.

metadata.note: Single image, general audience. Alt-text + caption required; no transcript. Compliance score should be 1.0.
